verses.text: My son, do not forget my teaching. Keep my commands in your heart,
because they will give you a long life, many years, and peace.
Never let kindness and faithfulness leave you. Tie them around your neck. Write them on your heart.
Then you will win favour and a good name with God and with people.
Trust in the LORD with all your heart. Do not depend on your own understanding.
In everything you do, remember him, and he will make your paths straight.
Do not think you are so wise. Respect the LORD and turn away from evil.
This will bring health to your body and strength to your bones.
Honour the LORD with your wealth, with the first and best part of everything you produce.
Then your barns will be full to overflowing, and your barrels will overflow with new wine.
My son, do not refuse the LORD's discipline. Do not be upset when he corrects you,
because the LORD corrects those he loves, just as a father corrects the son he delights in.
Happy is the person who finds wisdom, the person who gains understanding.
Wisdom is more valuable than silver. It pays better than gold.
She is worth more than rubies. Nothing you could want compares with her.
In her right hand she holds a long life. In her left hand she holds riches and honour.
Her ways are pleasant ways. All her paths lead to peace.
She is a tree of life to those who hold on to her. Those who hold her close will be happy.
The LORD used wisdom to lay the foundations of the earth. He used understanding to set the skies in place.
By his knowledge the deep waters burst open, and the clouds drop dew.
My son, do not let wisdom and good sense out of your sight. Hold on to them,
and they will give you life and be like a beautiful necklace around your neck.
Then you will walk safely on your way, and your foot will not trip.
When you lie down, you will not be afraid. When you lie down, your sleep will be sweet.
Do not be afraid of sudden disaster or of the ruin that comes on the wicked,
because the LORD will be your confidence. He will keep your foot from being caught in a trap.
Do not hold back good from those who deserve it when you are able to help.
Do not say to your neighbour, "Come back later. I will give it to you tomorrow," when you have it with you now.
Do not plan to harm your neighbour, who lives trustingly near you.
Do not argue with someone for no reason when they have done you no harm.
Do not be jealous of violent people, and do not copy any of their ways.
The LORD hates people who are twisted, but he is a close friend to honest people.
The LORD's curse is on the house of the wicked, but he blesses the home of good people.
He mocks those who mock, but he is kind to humble people.
Wise people will receive honour, but fools will only get shame.
